follow-up time: Retrospective review (specific follow-up time not mentioned)
exposure: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
Cause of PPH (uterine atony, placenta-related problems)
outcome: Late complications of UAE (including uterine necrosis)
cohort: 117 patients who underwent UAE for PPH
finding: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) was found to be safe and effective for treating postpartum hemorrhage (PPH), with a 99.1% success rate, but long-term follow-up is needed to assess potential complications like uterine necrosis and its effects on reproductive health.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with uterine necrosis after UAE for PPH.
